title: Portfolio Bandwidth Across a Business's Sites — Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas
content:
**Standard.** On Commercial Natural Gas Supply plans whose portfolio bandwidth term is Yes in the plan schedule, swing is measured on the business's whole portfolio rather than per site.

**The portfolio measure.** For a calendar month, the measure takes the billing cycles whose billing period start falls in that calendar month, across the business's agreements on plans with portfolio bandwidth that were active on that billing period start. It forms two sums over those agreements for those cycles:

1. the combined usage: the total therms on their energy charge lines and swing excess charge lines; and
2. the combined monthly contract volume: the total of their monthly contract volumes.

The portfolio is inside the bandwidth when the combined usage lies within each included plan's band applied to the combined monthly contract volume.

**Effect on billing.**

- When the combined usage falls inside every included plan's bandwidth, no site is billed swing that month, even if one site alone would be outside its own band.
- When the combined usage is outside, each included site is billed swing on its own usage against its own band.
- Sites on plans whose portfolio bandwidth term is No are always measured alone and do not enter the portfolio.

## Input, judgement, outcome

| Situation for the calendar month | Outcome for the sites in the portfolio |
|---|---|
| Combined usage inside the band of every included plan | No swing billed on any included site that month |
| Combined usage outside the band of an included plan | Each included site billed swing on its own usage against its own band |
| Site on a plan without portfolio bandwidth | Measured alone; never part of the portfolio sums |

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A bakery chain holds three Beacon Ridge Commercial Gas agreements: two sites on plans with portfolio bandwidth and one site on a plan without it, all active. In a cold month the first portfolio site runs above its own band and the second runs below its own band, and their combined usage lies within each of their plans' bands applied to their combined monthly contract volume. Neither portfolio site is billed swing for that month. The third site is measured alone against its own band, whatever the other two sites used.

## Basis questions

**Does a site join the portfolio for a month if its agreement was not active on its cycle's billing period start?** No. Only agreements on portfolio bandwidth plans that were active on that billing period start enter the sums.

**Which lines count toward the combined usage?** The energy charge lines and the swing excess charge lines of the included cycles.
